text:
alex: Heads-up — customer reported JSON-mode parse error in streaming responses. Repro + logs below. cc @ingrid @chris

alex: Customer error: "Error parsing JSON: invalid escape or unexpected token at position 482"

alex: Response snippet (they pasted):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/stream+json

{"id":1,"message":"Hello \\uD83D
"
... (next chunk) ...
"\uDE00!"}
```

maria: Customer repro steps: using node fetch streaming, piping chunks into an incremental parser. They only hit this when user inputs emoji or certain copy-pasted text. Repro request_id=rr-7f2a, model=gpt-redwood-3b-v1, region=eu-west-1

ingrid: This looks like a classic chunk boundary split inside a UTF-16 surrogate escape ("\uD83D" / "\uDE00"). Our streamer emits literal `\u` escapes; if we cut after the high surrogate escape it becomes invalid JSON until the low surrogate arrives. Incremental parsers fail on that.

chris: Can you attach the original request body and streaming headers? Any correlation with node versions / TLS chunking? Also need env: hosting=hosted, tier=standard

alex: Request body:
```
{
  "mode": "json",
  "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"message":{"type":"string"}}},
  "prompt": "Reply with emoji: 😀"
}
```

alex: Raw stream captured by customer (timestamps removed):
```
chunk 1: {"id":1,"message":"Hi \\uD83D
chunk 2: "\uDE00!"}
```

ingrid: Root cause: our chunker was splitting on bytes without checking for `\\u` escape sequences or incomplete `\\uXXXX` tokens. For surrogate pairs the `\\u` sequence needs to be kept contiguous. We'll push a sanitizer that buffers up to 6 bytes after a backslash and refrain from flushing mid-escape.

ingrid: Short-term workaround: set `stream: false` (non-streaming) or use the node SDK 0.9.1 which buffers and merges streaming chunks for JSON mode.

maria: Sent workaround to customer. They tried switching to `gpt-redwood-3b-v1-safe` (a variant with streaming sanitizer) and upgraded SDK; they reported no parse errors after 20 minutes.

chris: Filed internal ticket INF-4572, linked logs and request_id rr-7f2a. Will backport patch to stable streamers in all regions.

opsbot: Deploy triggered: streaming-sanitizer v1.2.4 -> canary -> eu-west-1 (2026-11-03T03:12:10Z)

ingrid: Adding regression test to avoid splitting `\\u` sequences and to protect against splitting `\\"` and `\\n` escapes as well.

alex: Thanks team. I'll mark the support case resolved and follow up with the customer success note. :white_check_mark:
